prompt: I want to define all the capabilities for a two-sided marketplace where buyers can browse and purchase digital goods and sellers can list items, manage inventory, and receive payouts. Do a comprehensive breakdown of the entire platform.
assertions: Output contains 'Problem Statement' section
Output contains 'Scope' section
Output contains 'Capabilities' section
Output contains 'Dependency Map' section
Output contains 'Open Questions' section
Output contains 'Research Suggestions' section
Output contains 'Next Steps' section
Depth level is marked as 'deep'
Covers 8-15 capabilities (deep depth)
Each capability has a Trigger field
Each capability has an Inputs field
Each capability has a Logic flow field
Each capability has an Outputs field
Each capability has an Edge cases field
Each capability has a Connects to field
Business problem is stated in Problem Statement
User problem is stated in Problem Statement
Success criteria are measurable
Logic flows describe WHAT not HOW (no tech stack, no code, no architecture)
Covers buyer-facing capabilities (browsing, search, purchasing)
Covers seller-facing capabilities (listing, inventory management)
Covers payment processing capability for buyer-to-platform transactions
Covers payout capability for platform-to-seller settlements
Covers dispute resolution or refund handling capability
Covers user account/onboarding capabilities for both sides
Dependency Map uses CAP-01 format for capability IDs
Research Suggestions reference the researcher skill
Does NOT attempt to save/persist the output — suggests librarian skill instead
Does NOT attempt to conduct its own research — flags topics for researcher skill
Checks for existing knowledge via librarian skill before starting
Flags at least 3 distinct research topics (e.g., marketplace fee models, escrow/trust, fraud detection)
Edge cases cover input validation scenarios
Edge cases cover dependency failure scenarios
Edge cases cover high-load or unusual conditions
Connects to shows clear dependency chains between capabilities
Open Questions includes unresolved design decisions
Next Steps lists concrete actions (e.g., prioritize capabilities, validate with users)
Output ends with a suggestion to use librarian skill for persistence
